1479-2841-3897-4488.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2841-3897-4488.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

413-1011-2728-4153.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
413-1011-2728-4153.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
413-1011-2728-4153.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4, dealing 1 damage.
Repeat from step 4.

5256-6854--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5256-6854--5--195.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Host of the Hereafter trigger.
Resolve Host of the Hereafter's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1379-2685-4186-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-2685-4186-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1115-2033-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1115-2033-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1115-2033-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

193-2104-2369-4423.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Aminatou's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Aminatou's second ability by removing a loyalty counter on it, blinking Mystic Sanctuary.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.
193-2104-2369-4423.notes: Mystic Sanctuary can be tapped for mana before casting Temporal Manipulation if it's able to do so.

628-1496-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is greater than half of Champion of the Weird's toughness rounded up.
628-1496-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird's ability by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on it.
If Champion of the Weird does not die as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, resolve the ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2, and continue activating the ability until Champion of the Weird dies.
When Champion of the Weird dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Champion of the Weird enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

618-3734--112.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Phyrexian Metamorph that has haste. Choose to have Phyrexian Metamorph enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Phyrexian Metamorph token instead.
618-3734--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must increase Phyrexian Metamorph's toughness.

997-2366-4452-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
997-2366-4452-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

5078-6766-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
5078-6766-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1330-4083-4090.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Truefire Captain.
Truefire Captain is indestructible.
1330-4083-4090.description:
Deal damage to Truefire Captain.
Truefire Captain and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Truefire Captain trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Truefire Captain instead of you due to Pariah.
Repeat from step 2.

2730-4050-6435.easyPrerequisites: There are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
2730-4050-6435.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Coati Scavenger, adding {B}.
When Coati Scavenger dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Coati Scavenger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Coati Scavenger enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform by paying {B}, attaching it to Coati Scavenger.
Repeat.

104-4631-4929.description:
Activate Essence Depleter by paying {1}{C}, causing you to gain 2 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

2034-2558-3490-6701-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-2558-3490-6701-6797.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

2201-2558-2981-5687.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Godhead of Awe, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1687-3129-3389-4050.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, attaching it to Siona.
Siona triggers, creating two 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Human Soldier tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

553-1403-3212-4432.description:
Move to your draw step, drawing Approach of the Second Sun and revealing it due to God-Eternal Kefnet's ability.
Resolve God-Eternal Kefnet's trigger, copying Approach of the Second Sun and casting the copy from your hand by paying {4}{W}.
Sunbird's Invocation triggers.
In response, activate Leashling by putting Approach of the Second Sun on top of your library, returning Leashling to its owner's hand.
Resolve the Sunbird's Invocation trigger, revealing the top seven cards of your library, casting Approach of the Second Sun without paying its mana cost, then putting the rest of the revealed cards on the bottom of your library.
Resolve Approach of the Second Sun, putting it back into your library seventh from the top and gaining you 7 life.
Resolve the remaining copy of Approach of the Second Sun.
